document.title: Frontier Regulatory Control Pack — FAA-N16 Demo Extract
document.sourceTitle: Notice on Recommendations on Investment Products
document.disclaimer: Curated fictional internal demonstration control pack. Not the official MAS notice, not legal advice, and not proof of regulatory compliance. Consult the authoritative notice and Compliance or Legal owners.

rules.title: Reasonable basis
rules.summary: Give due consideration to the client’s investment objectives, financial situation and particular needs.

rules.title: Collect and document client information
rules.summary: Collect and document objectives, risk tolerance, employment, financial situation, income, commitments, current portfolio and investment materiality, subject to applicable exceptions.

rules.title: Confirm no material change
rules.summary: Prior information may be relied upon only where the client confirms there are no material changes at the time of transaction.

rules.title: Incomplete information warning
rules.summary: Highlight that client information forms the recommendation basis and inaccurate or incomplete information may affect suitability.

rules.title: Customer Knowledge Assessment
rules.summary: Conduct a Customer Knowledge Assessment before recommending an applicable unlisted Specified Investment Product, subject to the notice.

rules.title: Customer Account Review
rules.summary: Conduct a Customer Account Review before recommending an applicable Listed Specified Investment Product, subject to the notice.

rules.title: Needs analysis
rules.summary: Analyze client information and identify a suitable product based on the information obtained.

rules.title: Product suitability factors
rules.summary: Consider product nature, key risks, tenor, fees and required liquidity when determining suitability.

rules.title: No suitable product
rules.summary: Inform the client where no suitable product can be identified.

rules.title: Explain and document basis
rules.summary: Explain the basis for the recommendation and document that basis.

rules.title: Recommendation documentation
rules.summary: Document objectives, financial situation and needs, the reasonable basis, and disadvantages based on the client’s circumstances.

rules.title: Client recommendation document
rules.summary: Furnish a summary of information gathered and the recommendation and its basis when making an investment recommendation, subject to the notice.

rules.title: Communication records
rules.summary: Maintain records of advisory communications for applicable Listed Specified Investment Products.

rules.title: Selected-client pre-transaction checks
rules.summary: Complete applicable documentation review and call-back controls before the effective date for selected clients or clients of selected representatives.

rules.title: Pre-transaction records
rules.summary: Keep records of applicable pre-transaction processes, methods, assessments and determinations for at least five years.
